info.name: Photo search
info.summary: Search photos and videos by what is in them, using Immich
info.description:
Find pictures in your Nextcloud by describing them: "woman on the beach", "dog in the snow", "birthday cake". The image understanding (CLIP) and face recognition come from a self-hosted [Immich](https://immich.app) that indexes your Nextcloud files read-only.
- **Everywhere you already search:** a "Photos by content" section in the unified search bar and in the Nextcloud mobile apps, plus a dedicated app with person and photo/video filters. - **Sort in bulk:** select many results (long-press on touch) and move or copy them into a folder. - **People:** name, merge and hide the faces Immich found – everyone only sees people from pictures they may open, with faces cut from those pictures. - **Opens the real file:** results are your Nextcloud files, shown in the Nextcloud viewer (videos play), with a jump to the containing folder. - **Nextcloud permissions decide:** one shared index, but every user only finds files they can open in Nextcloud themselves, their own and those shared with them. Thumbnails are checked too. - **No Immich account per user:** one service key, configured by the admin.
info.author: Florian Schneider
